summary: IM Cannabis Corp. (Nasdaq: IMCC), an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) announcing the September 29, 2026 closing of its sale of all shares of I.M.C. Holdings Ltd. to Slil.com Holding Ltd. Consideration was a previously received C$3,000,000 advance plus Slil's assumption of Retained Liabilities capped at C$9,400,000, excluding Target Subsidiary direct liabilities; no securities were issued. A pre-closing reorganization moved Israeli operations back into the Company; Adjupharm, Xinteza and Shiran were divested. Management estimates roughly C$3 million shareholders' equity improvement. A special committee was formed, but no advisor, regulatory clock or premium were disclosed. Watch accounting true-up versus that estimate.
